tasks.title: E26 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E26 (Someone needs help). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E26.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E26/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E26/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Implement the durable hub help service and safety evidence
ticket_tasks.brief:
Build the E26 hub help service, its two granted configuration documents and all Python evidence. One safety author owns this whole vertical slice. Leave the browser to T2/T3, urgency to E11, roles to E31, plans/guidance to E28/E27, model execution to E13/E12/E17, offline infrastructure to E20 and transport/card/composition to E29. Edit only owned_paths. Do not edit the frozen design, provider modules, generated contracts, root pyproject, fixtures, eval registry or AI-USE-LOG. PLAN Requests C1 to C7 are explicit dispatch/acceptance dependencies, not authority to invent their missing interfaces or claim their files. Coordinator must file the absent docs/requests/E26.md. The current repository has no hub/ui/eval or hub contracts. E01 kernel/testing/generated types allow component work; real acceptance waits for E01/E02/E23/E27-guidance and required scenario providers. Recheck all available docs/build/*/tasks.json ownership before editing.

Read the first four inputs in order. Implement design sections 1 to 6 and 8 to 12 with PLAN Design deviations. Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id, 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/ClockCorrections, 5.3 MissionClock, 5.4 Quantity/Unit, 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and shared ErrorEnvelope mapper, 5.6 ReleaseHandle/ConfigReader/ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseCheck/LoaderCheckRegistry/TemplateRenderer, 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot/StorageSession/OutboxEvent/Audience/ReplicationChange, 5.8 command_identity/IdempotencyStore/CommandReceipts/ResultVisibility, 5.9 AuditEntry, 5.10 Scheduler and elapsed/absolute deadlines, 5.10.1 TaskQueue/TaskRunner, 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec and 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Never create a clock, transaction manager, hash chain, migration runner, deduplication ledger, retry queue, scheduler or settings source. Register through the coordinator-supplied C1 artifact; that file is outside your grant. Add no shared mechanism locally. SYSTEM 6.2/6.4/6.5 govern uv, generated imports and guarded base/effective models.

Start with failing critical-path tests in hub/tests/help/ traced by exact T-E26 IDs and R/V/D/invariants. Then pure design 3 types PinnedHelpDocs, Flow, NodeRef, Subject, BodyRegionState, Tick, TurnRecord, HelpLogSnapshot; domain code imports only its own domain and kernel, with application mappers for provider facts. Use Quantity with UCUM s for delay across boundaries, never design 5.1 SQL REAL or bare Duration seconds across a port. Preserve nullable values and LIVE/REPLAY/SIM. Build triage only from goes_to, levels only from pinned presentation, ticks per visited flow, explicit-null region provenance, seq-ordered path/log and opener-as-first-helper for crewmate/unknown. Unknown subjects do not deduplicate. Person subjects have one open session under concurrent opens. A red flag joins without changing the node or pin. Reject assistant actors at the domain mutation boundary. Every applied change increments revision/log as specified; repeated idempotent ticks/crew call produce no new line.

Design 3.2 replay stops on node, unreadable version or changed normalized answer/target, never reinterprets indexes. Preserve remaining client commands for C3's schema-valid reconciliation protocol, not an undeclared applied_count JSON field. Tick flow_id targets the actual visited flow. Without it, stale revisions older than node_revision fail STALE_VERSION; with it, stale ticks cannot mark another flow's step. If-Match is required, other noncommuting actions need the current revision. Use SYSTEM 5.8 full command identity including canonical route target, semantic parameters/pin/origin and keyed private body fingerprint. Do not implement help_command/help_open_command as alternate ledgers or expire mission-life identity. Matching late retries return the authorized closed accepted_command receipt, never silently re-execute. Private text never enters generic result cache, audit, exception logs, replication or task payload.

Application ports copied from design 4.2/4.3 are the starting declarations, with the mandatory SYSTEM 8.1 PlanEscalation, PlanEscalationReader.read, PlanHelpEntry.open_from_plan_step/receipt and HelpEscalationReceipt replacing HelpSessionOpener.open_for_plan_step. Define those canonical types only in help/application/ports.py. Validate E28's committed intent under the trusted late binding; commit the child internal.plan_help_entry identity, immutable escalation receipt, help state, audit and help.session_changed together in E26's own UoW. Parent completion is E28's job. Retry returns the same receipt even if help has closed; joining never resets pins/flow. Test after intent/help/plan commit failures, closure and duplicate reconciliation events with real E28 for acceptance. E11's HelpEntryPort.open_from_red_flag(episode_id, answer_id, subject_person_id, flow_id, client_time, idempotency_key) uses engine opener and episode ref; SYSTEM 8.1 governs. E11 consumes help.session_changed durably and alone dispositions urgency.

C2 must settle canonical HelpSessionReader.context/readable_by, HelpLogSnapshots, bounded BroadcastQueries.active_for, E01 ObservationReadPort.latest_accepted and TextRulesPort, E03 ProfileFactsPort, WarningQueries/EpisodeRefPort, FlowPlanPort, HelpAssistantPort and BroadcastRolesSource before integration. Do not duplicate provider types or use SessionActor, SettingsPort.get, Clock.mission_hhmm, EnvironmentPort or provider domain imports from the old design. Use SessionContext, HubSettings, MissionClock and E23 MissionStatePort.current() as SYSTEM 4.4/5/8/9 specify. Read provider designs and approved request resolutions before binding; a missing signature is C2, not a locally guessed adapter. All returned collections and calls have registered limits/timeouts. Ref-check absence may retain an opaque unchecked entry reference for fixed help, never read or return unauthorized clinical details; authorization/storage/integrity failures cannot become a generic optional fallback.

SYSTEM 8.3 overrides design 3.5's broad session read roles. Session log/summary are clinical projections for current object/field/purpose grants, opener/current helper/subject only as allowed; officer status is no chart grant. Station gets P0 broadcasts and fixed help only. Implement ReadSubjectSummary from design 6 using corrected observed-time window including upper bound, received_at/id tie-break, nonnegative whole-minute ages, original REPLAY dates, source and unknown versus none_recorded. Successful reads require their audit; no store/audit failure may disclose data. Unknown subject is NOT_FOUND, close/leave/revocation UNAUTHORIZED_SCOPE. No summary grant reaches getObservation or any general record endpoint. Profiles fail to unknown, never no-allergies. Missing observations must be visibly unavailable, never fabricated empty success. C2 provides the trusted read and grant snapshot. Store no summary on the client or in tasks/events.

Build the configuration-only assistant guard from design 3.6/3.7 and review 1/3/21: inspect every string in action/tool/limitations, enforce configured amount and medicine checks, fully segment every displayed field into eligible complete references, reject appended narrative and hidden-field doses, render only configured text and citations. G1 distinguishes action retrieve_evidence from tool search_evidence, per E12 section 3.3 and the actual tool catalog. No arbitrary treatment reference from free-text kit. SYSTEM 8.2 and Part A Q1/Q7/Q18 override the unreviewed-LIVE rejection in test 057: unreviewed sourced purpose-eligible content is labeled, never blocked solely on review. Withdrawn/rejected content, wrong hash/pin/purpose/environment, unavailable equipment/consumable per-use stock, skill/operator and unknown facts still deny guidance; no optimistic defaults. Use real E27 guidance through application mapping. For fixed emergency entry, missing optional facts label uncertainty without hiding the validated first screen.

Maintain design TurnRecord/context_epoch and one-active/one-pending semantics, held asks at triage, cancellation on node/start-over/close and per-asker help conversation without readings/journal. Use shared internal tasks/generations, no public Job kind or local worker polling/retry thread. Work inputs are references to bounded owner records. C2 must settle E13's authoritative guard transaction and publication before coding callbacks: no nested UoW, no detached old FlowPlanSnapshot authorizing current guidance and no raw model text stored or streamed. Recheck current grant, epoch, source pins and eligibility atomically at apply. Late/duplicate/cancelled/restarted generations never publish. Timeout is an elapsed deadline under SYSTEM 5.10; contact/arrival instants are absolute and do not shift on clock correction.

GroundMessage/HelpLogSnapshot follow design 3.3 and SYSTEM 8.1: preview/press share the pure composer; press persists approved lines, UTF-8 text hash, revision and snapshot atomically without optional port calls. Includes every tick in visit/index order, crew call and extra_note only. Full generated GroundMessage includes all nullable fields, catch_up, leaves_at and allowed_actions, no composition_pending. Persist the approval-time catch_up facts through C4 alongside the approved snapshot. Optional read enrichment may set current link display/status, never alter approved clinical facts or hash; later newly shared facts require another approval. Reconcile E29 P29-1 before binding a transaction-bound pure composer; no worker call or nested UoW in the press. Missing composer fallback preserves known done steps/crew line and uses configured unknown for watch/advice, not nothing_watched. Do not import groundlink.application.ports into help. GroundMessagePreview's required ground_link needs C4's approved absent-provider representation; no fake up/down/source. Event identity retains duplicate/reordered receipt/reply facts once, buffering unmet transitions, preserving both distinct replies and latest wire reply after close without reopening or changing care. Ground receives approved delivered projections only. groundlink owns ground-scope delivery events; E26 emits currently authorized onboard events, with help.session_changed never broadcast to all crew/station. No journal/participation/raw chart export; local-only ReplicationChange when no allowed export exists.

Storage in the single owned 0001_help.sql uses WAL/FULL/STRICT/FK through E01 StorageSession and atomic UoW. Known names from design 5.1: help_session, help_path, help_log, help_tick, help_helper, help_assistant_turn; canonical SYSTEM 4.2 names include help_action, help_broadcast, help_ground_message, help_log_snapshot. C1 must settle the remaining exact incoming-event/receipt schema and conflicting table layout before migration is finalized. Never invent a prefix/name or read another module's tables. No destructive rollback. Preserve body-region source, node revision, epoch, original/corrected times and immutable pins. Register all design 5.4 bounds with concrete min/max/basis through the authorized C1 artifact, using shared storage.busy_timeout_ms rather than a second writer policy. No commands accepted without ledger/audit/outbox/replication atomicity. Soft cap refuses note/ask only; hard/path/admission limits fail loud into continued local guidance with unsaved records. Disk full, busy, I/O and failed commit abort, stay retryable and use E01 reserve/health behavior, never a successful partial command.

API operationIds copied from docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:8462 onward: openHelpSession POST /v1/help-sessions, listHelpSessions GET same, getHelpSession GET /v1/help-sessions/{help_session_id}, actOnHelpSession POST .../actions, getHelpSubject GET .../subject, previewGroundMessage GET .../ground-message-preview, queueGroundMessage POST .../ground-messages, getGroundMessage GET /v1/ground-messages/{ground_message_id}, listBroadcasts GET /v1/help/broadcasts, createUrgentEvent POST /v1/urgent-events. Alias shares the open handler, preserves its declared entry kind. Generated HelpSessionCreate/HelpAction/GroundMessageCreate and response schemas are the sole wire types. Keep 201 on second press until R-E26-1 lands. Match authorized matching receipt separately from conflicting DUPLICATE_COMMAND. Refuse unknown subject IDs and mismatched self, honor roster and entry constraints. No new endpoint, enum, replay/citation/replies/review_state field or D12 overlay for a pending request.

Create config/responder-flows.json as a byte-for-byte copy of docs/product/responder-flows.json; do not change its content. Create config/help-presentation.json from the unwrapped value of the opened config example, validated through schema and loader checks, keeping sources/basis/notice. This example seed is an explicit SIM test/demo release, never an automatic production fallback. Production release content/provenance must be deliberately provisioned by its owner. E26 contributes loader checks 3/10 and normalized uniqueness plus applicable template validation through E01's registry. config/ui-copy.json and other documents belong elsewhere. Missing Who/air-safety/review/citation/copy shapes are C5/R-E26-5/6/7. Use only valid existing configured fallbacks, report blocked positive cases and never hardcode labels. Test scratch text/broadcast changes with no safety mapping edit; old sessions pin exact previous bytes; corrupt candidates leave last good. Implement print_cards parity from the same pinned release and notice under design 9 and DEPLOYMENT 7.1; C1/R-E20-3 supplies CLI mounting, not a new CLI framework.

Test inventory: own all design 12 IDs except T2 073/080/081/082/086/087/088/096/105/112 and T3 070/071/074/095/100/104. Your tests include 001/002 optional failure isolation; 010 to 023 parser/rule/replay/interleavings/body-region/concurrent helpers; 030/031 broadcast; 040 to 046 and 097 privacy/freshness/revocation; 050 to 059 including corrected 057 guard/epochs; 060 to 069/075 ground approval/replies/link identity/canaries; 072 red flag; 085 activation; 090/091 actual effective contract and Schemathesis; 092 to 094 durable retries; 101/102/103/110/111/113/114 resources, roles, print and real faults. Add Hypothesis flow parsing/normalization/segmentation/action properties and independently checked contract routing golden cases, not expected medical outcomes derived from the same modified config. Inputs use config/explicit fixture. A removed primary must exercise local/printed/human backup through T3. Configuration edit evidence applies to each mechanism, including guard rendered reference text, without tuning safety mappings.

Write HTTP end to end counterparts for PLAN's triage/shared help, limited readings, assistant, ground, configuration and durability rows, tracing every E26 V/D and critical-path contribution. They run the real create_app(settings) and temporary real SQLite with real E02 auth, E23 mission, E27 guidance and required installed providers; no hub overrides, fake repositories/queries or direct SQL clinical seeding. Setup goes through accepted commands and explicit E21 demo profile. Optional model/devices/ground processes may be absent or their documented external fakes. Unit tests use kernel.testing with injected clock/IDs; never substitute them into HTTP acceptance. Faults cover crash before/after state/ledger/audit/outbox/replication and commit/response; disk full, lock timeout and audit failure; conflicting simultaneous actions; 30-hour retry with changed target/body/parameters; clock forward/backward and mission boundary; missing/corrupt config, all bounds, incapacitated/absent crew, private canaries and long outage/backlog. Propagate storage/integrity failures across optional wrappers. Real E13/E28/E29 integrations are separate positive tests and cannot pass from absence-only cases.

Done means all owned unit/property/contract/HTTP/fault tests collect and pass, effective contract corpus valid, at least 95 percent branch independently across domain/application with no unmeasured safety files, complete condition coverage and complexity at most 15 per safety function, mutmut at least 80 percent for every listed design 12 safety file with survivors reviewed. hub/tests/help/tools/mutation_gate.py is owned and must reject missing/no-mutant/incomplete reports; do not implement a fake score. C6 supplies pinned compatible mutmut CLI/shared gate registration. Run exact gates below, then full hub suite after a fix. No greenlight while registration, required shared bindings, CI or independent review are outstanding. Record measurements with real machine/release identity; no unmeasured performance/clinical claim. Coordinator records this AI run outside your scope.
gates: uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/help hub/tests/help
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/help hub/tests/help
uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/help
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output /tmp/e26-imports.ini
uv run --project hub lint-imports --config /tmp/e26-imports.ini

uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/help --cov=crew_health.help.domain --cov=crew_health.help.application --cov-branch --cov-report=json:/tmp/e26-coverage.json --cov-fail-under=95
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py coverage --report /tmp/e26-coverage.json
uv run --project hub mutmut run --paths-to-mutate hub/src/crew_health/help/domain
uv run --project hub python hub/tests/help/tools/mutation_gate.py --min 80
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated trace safety
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py corpus
uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests

ticket_tasks.title: Implement cached help rendering and owner-safe reference replay
ticket_tasks.brief:
Build only the E26 crew feature and its component/property tests, plus stryker.help.conf.json. This task owns no Python, end to end browser directory, shell/router/sign-in/config files, E20 offline infrastructure or E29 ForTheGroundCard. T3 owns browser acceptance; T1 owns the hub/ports/configuration. Start independently once E01 generated @crew-health/contracts and the approved E03/E20 integration contracts exist. T2 does not wait for T1 just to implement pure local behavior and component tests. Do not invent shared TS interfaces, runtime API responses or provider exports to compensate for absent code. The repository currently has no ui/hub/eval. PLAN C1 to C7 are concrete acceptance holds and do not grant new owned files. Read AGENTS, SYSTEM and Part A first, then DEPLOYMENT, design/reviews and the other reads. Coordinator must canonically file the absent docs/requests/E26.md.

Implement design sections 3.2, 5.2 to 5.4, 6 to 10 and 12 with SYSTEM 4.4/5.6/5.8/5.11/6.3/8.2/8.3/8.6 and DEPLOYMENT 5.5.1 overrides. Vue 3 and TypeScript strict. Import generated request/response/client types from @crew-health/contracts only. Generated HelpSession, HelpSessionCreate, HelpAction, SubjectSummary, CrewBroadcast, GroundMessagePreview and GroundMessage correspond to the read schemas. Components/calls: HelpButton.vue opens HelpScreen.vue from memory at /help and /help/:id; WhoStep.vue, TriageQuestion.vue, FlowSteps.vue and FixedButtons.vue render the pinned node/configured buttons; AirSafetyLine.vue consumes airSafety.ts; AssistantLine.vue, ReadingsPanel.vue, Reconciliation.vue, HelpLog.vue and BroadcastLine.vue follow design 7. Keep help in the main bundle, no lazy network load before first paint. The design's exact slot/props are pending C3: E03 mounts stage.head.help and screen.top.broadcast, including sign-in; E31 RoleRows, E30 CoachingLine, E28 plan card, E32 supply use and E29 ForTheGroundCard are provider-owned. Do not build copies or edit shell mounts. T3 proves actual mounting with real providers, not a local fake alone.

Write tests first traced to T-E26-073/080/081/082/086/087/088/096/105/112, R15/R39/R43, V01/V60/V64/V75/V97 help contribution, D15/D22 to D26/D41/D42 and I-H1/H2/H7/H11 to H14 as applicable. localFlow.ts is a bounded pure engine over the pinned triage/flow documents, no authored clinical routing/text. Not sure follows goes_to, never an invented safe answer. air_safe precedes Who and any questions; a non-yes immediately opens its configured flow with unknown subject. C5/R-E26-5 must supply exact Who/self route and air-safety words before full positive acceptance, no guessed answer index or hardcoded text. All source/version/review notices visible, unreviewed source-eligible content labels follow Q1/Q7/Q18, not a blanket LIVE block. Missing equipment/source/eligibility cannot enable procedures/measurements/doses. Fixed validated emergency entry persists despite optional fact/provider absence.

cache.ts selects help content and retains pins through E20 DocumentStore, not a new IndexedDB document database. docs/requests/E20.md R-E20-4 proposes DocumentStore.put/get/active/lastGood/retain/release via ui/crew/src/offline/index.ts; these are pending until approved C3. Use exact approved exports when delivered. E20 alone validates atomic immutable raw-byte bundles, pointer swaps, retention refs, bootstrap publication and shared schema/hash mechanisms. E26 may validate its own flow references/normalized uniqueness and prepare parsed local state. No second DocumentStore, service worker, generic cache or key store. Never reserialize public getConfigDocument JSON to verify a raw-byte version or invent a historical version parameter. C3/R-E20-10 supplies signed raw bundles. Active, last good, trusted help-bootstrap.json, independently verified static markup then printed procedure is the fallback order. Retain every open/pending pin; interrupted/corrupt release does not reinterpret an old answer/step index. Pre-auth entry requires no owner key, sign-in or writable IndexedDB. With all artifacts invalid, preserve the verified static/human path; never fabricate an empty successful flow.

journal.ts owns reference-only help intent/replay semantics through the E20/E02 storage/crypto lifecycle agreed in C3. Allowed durable bodies contain node IDs, answer indexes, flow_id and subject references only, never add_note/ask_assistant/private text, readings or response views. One immutable intent binds UUIDv7 key at action time, operation, canonical target/path parameters, semantic If-Match/release/origin, actor/device/site/mission partition, source clock provenance, client time and dependencies. Retrying never changes body/pin/ETag/key. E20 owns AES-GCM, owner-wrapped key generations/nonces, unlock and atomic multi-tab claims. Do not persist an unwrapped CryptoKey as the frozen design proposes. Lock/sign-out/401/expiry/owner switch/revocation destroys in-memory keys/plaintext/drainers and fences delayed callbacks by E03 session epoch; retain ciphertext quarantined for its original owner. Person B cannot decrypt or send A's commands. Missing approved crypto keeps additional capture visibly unsaved and does not hide fixed guidance.

Pre-auth actions cannot be silently attributed/decrypted under the next signer. C3 must settle unowned reference capture, consented attribution, immutable identity and release retention with E02/E20. Until that protocol exists, keep visibly unsaved reference work in memory and retain emergency guidance; do not claim durable offline acceptance. For owned queues, drain in dependency/creation order within registered client.retry_* and journal bounds. Original per-flow ticks replay even after switching flows. Lost responses retry exactly; full authorized 2xx or verified SYSTEM 5.8 accepted_command receipt is acceptance. A generic 409, wrong target/key/operation, identity mismatch, absent receipt, revoked grant or replay truncation cannot delete intent. Keep rejected/unapplied entries with old pinned labels in Reconciliation.vue; an explicit changed action is a new intent, never an automatic key replacement. C3 supplies schema-valid hub replay progress, no invented applied_count property. At quota/full path/log/storage bounds continue local instructions, call_crew and printed human backup with unsaved count/style and configured error words, never a saved tick.

Use actual generated operations openHelpSession/createUrgentEvent, getHelpSession/actOnHelpSession, getHelpSubject, listBroadcasts and previewGroundMessage/queueGroundMessage/getGroundMessage (API path/operationIds at docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:8462 to 9340). E29's card owns preview/press UI; E26 exposes its documented slot, no duplicate approval flow. HelpAction.flow_id always accompanies a tick. On STALE_VERSION respect the hub merge/rejection and show current state without reinterpreting pending local care. Configuration release never resets pinned session. Closed session is read-only. Practice mode uses cache only, no API/broadcast, labeled drill. No participation content on medical/help surfaces.

airSafety.ts initializes independently of Today using listWarnings/GET /v1/warnings?state=active at signed-in startup and warning events. Persist only P0/P1 shared habitat/crew act/emergency snapshot, no personal warning/log. Stale/failed hub refresh shows configured sensor_quiet time and preserves air_safe first; no safe-air claim or vehicle alarm control. Missing exact instruction is C5, not permission to use hardcoded PRD text. SubjectSummary remains memory-only with Cache-Control no-store at hub: source/origin/observation time and nonnegative age; monotonic elapsed age growth within process epoch, expiry at pinned max_age_minutes, refresh on help.session_changed and configured interval; failed refresh is visibly stale. Clear panel and assistant private state on leave/close/route exit/sign-out/403/grant loss, including in-flight results after epoch change. No clinical session event/read access for ungranted crew, officer or station; station broadcast handle grants no chart. T1's wire grant overrides the frozen broad roles. Preserve partial/missing/conflicting readings without inventing measured values.

AssistantLine renders only the hub's accepted configured text; pending citations are highlighted by configured step text as design interim, never guess a wire citations field. No raw streaming model output or unsupported action text. Fixed steps render before/beside assistant and role rows. All words come from pinned responder-flows, help-presentation/ui-copy and authorized backend state; vocabulary keys/routes/CSS/event names are implementation constants only. No authored clinical text, thresholds, units, medicine names or copy fallback in source. C5 owns missing copy additions. Tests edit scratch step/broadcast/label text, not safety mapping, and prove rendering changes without code. Use E03 tokens, 44px targets/focus, broadcast aria-live level, no animation on help.

Test 073 warnings cold initialization/stale/offline; 080 client literal scan; 081 scratch document content change; 082 no-request practice; 086 interrupted activation and old pin/reordered answer/reconnect; 087 monotonic age/expiry/stale/discard and delayed response after lock/leave; 088 fast-check parser/normalization and journal identity/reducer properties; 096 account switch/preauth and wrong-owner replay; 105 signed-out cold entry/expired authentication/missing IndexedDB/corrupt active+last-good+bootstrap/static fallback; 112 quota fail-loud. Extend with D6 receipt exact target/parameters, 30-hour retry, two offline flows, ownership lock while decrypt/drain, multiple tabs, max bounds and corrupt/missing docs. Use approved test adapters for component tests only, and injected times, no wall-clock clinical expectations. Externally kill/restart scenarios belong to T3. Do not edit shared E20 tests or manifests.

Done: owned component/property/static tests pass, pnpm typecheck strict, eslint/prettier clean, Stryker at least 80 percent killed for each E26 localFlow.ts/journal.ts/cache.ts adapter with reviewed survivors and nonempty reports, configured content edit proof, every required branch/error/cleanup handled and T3 integration defects resolved. stryker.help.conf.json must select owned component tests only and fail on missing tests, mutation inventory or threshold. No aggregate score hides an untested journal. E20 storage/crypto mutation evidence belongs to E20. Gate commands below require C6's actual pnpm scripts and pinned tools; missing scripts/providers/tests fail, never become skip/xfail or a handwritten fake service. After bug fixes rerun the full owned UI suite. Coordinator logs the run; green CI/resolved independent review are still required.
gates: pnpm -C ui/crew typecheck
pnpm -C ui/crew exec eslint src/features/help
pnpm -C ui/crew exec prettier --check src/features/help stryker.help.conf.json
pnpm -C ui/crew test -- features/help
pnpm -C ui/crew exec stryker run stryker.help.conf.json

ticket_tasks.title: Prove E26 scenarios through the real crew UI and composed hub
ticket_tasks.brief:
Own only ui/crew/e2e/help/ and write the E26 real-browser acceptance suite. This task starts after T1 and T2 are implemented. Do not edit their source/tests, shell/offline/provider modules, fixture, config, shared Playwright configuration, eval runner or CI. Report defects to their owner with a failing scenario. Read AGENTS, SYSTEM, Part A and DEPLOYMENT first; design is frozen and PLAN deviations win. The current checkout has no real hub/UI and all gates here are future requirements. C1 to C7 must supply composition/toolchain, approved interfaces, actual fixture and observation/fault controls before acceptance. No fake internal hub or invented helper script may stand in for a missing provider. Read every installed provider's actual application ports before driving it; absent implementation blocks that positive scenario.

Implement design 7/9/10/11/12: own original T-E26-070 (air safety), 071 (screen ordering), 074 (whole V60), 095 (two offline flows), 100 (first screen latency) and 104 (hub loss/replay). Expand these with the component cases from T2 into each end to end row in PLAN, covering all E26-01/02/03/04, R15/R39/R43/R61, V01/V60/V61/V62/V63/V64/V68/V71/V75 and D15/D22/D23/D24/D25/D26/D41, plus D42 and V97 help contribution. Retain complete cross-epic acceptance obligations, including V75 threshold/environment and V97 active-plan counterparts as separately registered provider evidence; help-only does not pass them. E21 registers your actual nodes through C6 and checks every listed clause. Do not add an unowned eval/scenarios directory just to fit the obsolete design 15 command.

Every test drives Playwright through the actual built crew app served with a running hub built via SYSTEM 5.12 create_app(settings), real E01 loader/generated schemas/middleware/UoW/audit/outbox/command receipts, real E02 auth/grants, E23 mission and E27 guidance, using a real temporary-directory SQLite database. Initialize through public/approved owner commands and E21 fixtures/demo-mara-fd19 explicit demo profile. No test production branch, mocked repository/query/eligibility, FastAPI dependency override, browser route.fulfill, synthetic in-hub service or direct SQL clinical seeding. No inline invented clinical content; expected step words selected by pin/ID and golden routing expectations independently checked against CONTRACTS. Documented external E17 model stub, absent optional devices/model/link and bounded E01/E20 storage/process fault controls are allowed at their actual boundaries. Units, origin, original observation times and config hashes must travel through the real stack. A missing observer cannot be replaced with a claim that no calls happened.
